report_identity.report_title: China Electronics Huada Technology Company Limited Annual Report 2024

business_overview.one_sentence: The group designs and sells integrated circuit chips, mainly smart card and secure element chips, and develops application systems.

segments.name: Integrated circuit products and services
segments.source: Annual Report 2024, note 5 revenue and segment information, p.129

business_overview.revenue_model: Most revenue is from sale of goods, recognised when control is transferred to customers.
business_notes: Products are used in identity authentication, financial payment, government utilities, telecommunications, IoT and Internet of Vehicles.
2024 market demand for smart cards and secure element chips was sluggish; selling prices continued to decline and total sales volume fell 9.7%.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Three-year free cash flow is positive, but 2024 operating cash flow fell to 0.47x parent net profit. The main 2024 working capital cash drag came from contract liabilities, trade and other payables, offset by inventory and receivable releases.

gaps: Annual report does not split consolidated cash and deposits by parent versus each PRC subsidiary.
Annual report does not disclose maturity bands for the bank/related-party time deposits beyond current and non-current aggregate totals.
Maintenance versus growth capital expenditure is not separately disclosed; purchase of property, plant and equipment and intangible assets is used as conservative capex evidence.
